ma.startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery(Object object)

Start searching for nearby Bluetooth peripherals (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
services Array No List of UUIDs for Bluetooth device master services to search for (supports 16/32/128-bit UUIDs). Some Bluetooth devices broadcast the UUID of their main service. If this parameter is set, only Bluetooth devices whose broadcast packets have the main service corresponding to the UUID will be searched. It is recommended to use this parameter to filter out other surrounding Bluetooth devices that do not need to be processed.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Array services

Object ArrayItem
Attribute Type Description
uuid String UUID of the Bluetooth device service
isPrimary Boolean Whether the service is the main service

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery: ok

Sample Code

ma.startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery({
  success: (res) => {
    console.log('startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery success', res)
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'discovery success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
  fail: (res) => {
    console.log('startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery fail', res)
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'discovery fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
})

F&Qs

Q: When searching for nearby Bluetooth peripherals on an Android machine, the device cannot be found. How to troubleshoot?

A: If you are unable to search for nearby Bluetooth devices using an Android phone for a long time, you can check whether the phone's location service is turned on, and try to search for the device again after confirming that it is turned on.
